name: Champion of Venus: Tayla's Big Adventure
source:
[b][i]The Tournament of Eros is over...[/i][/b]

...So why are the Champions still in the city? And what's with this creepy [b]invitation?[/b]

Something weird is going on - and it has something to do with the old, abandoned [b]stadium[/b] in the heart of the city.

[b][i]The realms of lust are under new management...[/i][/b]

As the new Queen of Lust, [b]Venus[/b] has to solve this mystery...but with her Champion on a divine vacation, there's only one mortal she can turn to.

Join [b]Tayla[/b] on a big, busty adventure like no other! Unravel a conspiracy of gods and monsters, square off with lustful Champions, and uncover the stadium's mysteries!

[b][i]Like, totally![/i][/b]

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2517190/]Steam[/url]]
